title: Spaghetti westerns
blurb: Westerns made in Italy and shot in Spain: dirtier, stranger and louder than Hollywood's, usually with Morricone on the soundtrack.

films.note: Franco Nero drags a coffin through the mud. It had so many unofficial sequels nobody has counted them.
A mute gunfighter in the snow, and one of the bleakest endings in any western.
Lee Van Cleef and a young man hunting the same gang. Tarantino used its theme in Kill Bill.
Lee Van Cleef hunting Tomas Milian across Mexico.
The Mexican Revolution, with Gian Maria Volonté.
Lee Van Cleef teaches a town's errand boy to shoot, and regrets it.
